title.narrative: Equipping kidney dialysis centers in the Syrian Arab Republic with equipment, supplies, and solutions

description.narrative: Improving healthcare services for kidney failure patients across various Syrian governorates. Securing essential life-saving treatment (dialysis kits). Enhancing the capabilities of specialized dialysis centers. Alleviating the financial burden and human suffering of patients affected by the deterioration of the health sector due to the Syrian crisis. Reducing pressure on existing centers, expanding geographical coverage, and alleviating the burden of travel and high treatment costs for patients. Supporting recovery and reconstruction efforts in the health sector and contributing to capacity building for local staff. Contributing to reducing mortality rates among kidney failure patients in Syria.

Strengthening the Syrian healthcare system's capacity to provide life-saving dialysis services by supplying affected health facilities with 454 modern dialysis machines and securing the necessary consumables (kittle kits). This will ensure the continuity of treatment for kidney failure patients, alleviate the humanitarian burden, improve the quality of healthcare during the post-crisis recovery phase in Syria, and ultimately reduce mortality rates by providing free treatment.

Supporting healthcare recovery efforts and increasing the capacity of dialysis centers by providing (454) dialysis machines, which contributes to alleviating the suffering of kidney failure patients, training 1200 health personnel, which contributes to having teams capable of operating the new machines with high efficiency, raising the level of readiness and response in dialysis units, reducing the rates of medical complications and reducing deaths, reducing the migration of specialized health personnel and localizing the specialized service, providing (108,960) dialysis sessions, and the readiness of dialysis units to receive (9080) beneficiaries of kidney failure patients and supporting the Ministry of Health’s efforts in providing its services to its citizens.
